title: World Bloom — With You at SEKAI's Beginnings — Episode10 Shows for Smiles

meta.Event Outline: From their space between worlds, Miku and the others watch over everyone. Just then, a fragment appears before them. It takes them to see everyone at the moment their true feelings were born.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (I knew that fragment-like object would send me somewhere, but why a hospital...?)

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“I'm not about to lose!
I will win this battle!!”

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Yes, it's Tsukasa and Saki when they were little...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (I'm still not sure why, but it seems that I've been sent back to one of their old memories.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (They both seem to be having so much fun...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (I'm sensing a particularly strong desire coming from Tsukasa.)

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line:
It was so nice to see Saki smiling.
Thank you for putting such a fun show on for us, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hehe. You're welcome!
I spent a lot of time coming up with it just for Saki!

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm glad that I got to see Saki smile today.

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line: Anyway, I'm going to start coming up with my next show after we get home!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (He wants to make someone smile, just like the show he saw with Saki when they were little...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Is this the fragment that's destined to blossom into that SEKAI...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I hope that desire keeps growing stronger and stronger...

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line: “And so, after saving the planet, the Pegasus Adventurers decided to travel into outer space.”

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line: What?! They went into outer space?!

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line:
That's right!
But don't worry! Next up is the Milky Way arc, so stay tuned!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Hehe. They seem to be having an enjoyable time again today...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Plus, that story was so grand and imaginative, just like Tsukasa himself. I couldn't help but smile.)

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line: Thanks for always coming up with these shows for me, Tsukasa...

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line: You always make things super duper fun!

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad to hear that!

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line: And I'm going to keep coming up with special shows that make everyone smile!

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line:
Really?
But isn't that gonna be really hard?

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line: No, because I'm going to become the biggest star in the world!

rows.Speaker: Little Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm going to come up with even more shows, and make you and so many other people smile and laugh, Saki!

rows.Speaker: Little Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe. I know you will, Tsukasa!
So, do your best!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Oh, that fragment's starting to glow even brighter...)
